verdict.rationale: Amplitude documents a shared 'consent model' across SDKs and session-replay controls to 'mask sensitive content, honor consent, and control what gets captured,' which is the only evidence touching opt-out/consent, but there is no explicit documentation of an AI-native user opting out of Amplitude's own usage tracking or telemetry collection about themselves. missing for 10: explicit opt-out/DNT mechanism documentation, description of how consent choices are enforced, independent confirmation the opt-out actually works.
